first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, which is the most acute metric degradation. Memory_91 shows in-product activation messaging improved week-one engagement; memory_86 confirms onboarding improvements lift adoption. Rather than compete on price (memory_73 is SMB-focused and defensive), activation messaging targets the core friction point while preserving enterprise conversion paths (memory_44). Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the durability and mechanism of activation gains. A standard experiment tests this against the current baseline, which has room to recover without broad rollout risk. This preserves budget for price response if competitor pressure intensifies while addressing the immediate engagement gap.
